correctness.rationale: Exact interior continuants and palindromic inverse formula imply uniform inverse decay and a fixed interior spectral gap. At energy zero the endpoint Schur matrix has eigenvalues ±2^{-q} and its energy derivative is negative with asymptotic magnitude 5/3. Log-determinant derivative O(q) gives two and only two eigenvalues ±(3/5)2^{-q}+O(q4^{-q}), q=2k+1, and the inverse norm coefficient 10/3. Reconstructed finite q=1 and exact-rational 126 identities as well as small high-precision spectra from checker.py; these supplements are not used as infinite proofs.
